index=endpoint sourcetype="symantec:ep:risk:file" signature=*
| stats count AS detections

((index=auth sourcetype=linux_secure) OR (index=wineventlog sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security")) action IN ("failure", "failed", "fail")
| timechart span=1h count AS failures

index=wineventlog sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode IN (4720, 4722, 4724, 4725, 4726, 4738, 4740, 4767)
| stats count AS changes BY EventCode

index=wineventlog sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode IN (4672, 4728, 4732, 4756)
| stats count AS events values(EventCode) AS event_codes BY user dest
| sort - events

((index=auth sourcetype=linux_secure) OR (index=wineventlog sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security")) action="success" user IN ("admin", "administrator", "root", "guest", "sa", "default", "test")
| stats count AS logins values(src) AS sources BY user dest
| sort - logins

index=firewall sourcetype="pan:config" ("configuration change" OR "config change" OR "%ASA-5-111008" OR "%ASA-5-111010" OR type=CONFIG)
| stats count AS changes latest(_time) AS last_change BY host user
| convert ctime(last_change)

index=wineventlog sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode IN (1102, 104, 4719, 4906, 4907)
| table _time dest user EventCode
| sort - _time

((index=auth sourcetype=linux_secure) OR (index=wineventlog sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security")) action IN ("failure", "failed", "fail")
| stats count AS failures dc(user) AS accounts BY dest
| sort - failures
